svg.text: Figure 1. In-range depth after the shock: D_1% / D_pre by minutes since t1_last
line = pointwise median across pool-episodes; band = 25th to 75th percentile; dashed red = the 0.9 recovery level
x: minutes since t1_last, shown in hours (0 to 72 h). y: D_1% / D_pre, axis 0 to 2.0; nothing is clipped (largest 75th percentile 1.66).
Source: depth/series (frozen driver), decision.json, results_<chain>.jsonl; drawn read-only by tools/report_figures.py. Full caption in the report.
